delivery.title: Your password
delivery.subtitle: One-time link to retrieve your server password.
delivery.intro: For security, the password is not sent by email. Click the button to reveal it; it will be shown only once on this screen.
delivery.onceNote: The link expires after 24 hours and can only be used once.
delivery.warnOnce: Save them now: for security they will not be shown again.
delivery.errNotFound: This link doesn't exist or isn't correct. Make sure you copied it in full from the email.
delivery.errUsed: This link has already been used. For security the password is shown only once; if you didn't save it, request a new one from your dashboard or from support.
delivery.errExpired: This link has expired (valid for 24 hours). Ask for the credentials to be resent from your dashboard or from support.
delivery.errUnavailable: The delivery service is unavailable right now. Please try again in a few minutes.
delivery.errGeneric: Something went wrong retrieving the password. Please try again or contact support.
